steps: Test Option A: Velocity parallel to uniform E means electrostatic force is collinear with velocity. Acceleration is along the path, so it remains a straight line. (Correct)
Test Option B: Velocity perpendicular to uniform E means constant acceleration perpendicular to constant velocity (like a projectile). The path is a parabola. (Correct)
Test Option C: Velocity parallel to uniform B means magnetic force q(v x B) is zero. The particle moves in a straight line, not a helix. (Incorrect)
Test Option D: Velocity perpendicular to uniform B means a constant magnetic force acts normal to the velocity, providing centripetal force for a circular path. (Correct)
